reason: The file-level and function-level descriptions are highly accurate and closely match the implementation. Nearly every behavioral detail is captured: the recursive tree traversal, header copying, separator/section defaulting, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH handling, flag formatting with shorthand/NoOptDefVal/string quoting, SEE ALSO parent propagation of DisableAutoGenTag, HISTORY section conditionality, and the md2man rendering pipeline. The descriptions are detailed enough that a model could reconstruct the file with high fidelity.
missing_functionality: GenManTreeFromOpts: the description does not mention that when header is nil a new empty GenManHeader is allocated before use (the nil-check at the top of the function).

manPrintFlags: the description says 'Appends an optional value placeholder using square brackets when NoOptDefVal is set' but does not clarify that the opening bracket is appended before the value format and the closing bracket after, which is a subtle ordering detail needed for exact reconstruction.
genMan: the description does not mention that the EXAMPLE section uses a fenced code block with a newline before and after the example text (```\n%s\n```).
incorrect_or_misleading_points: fillHeader: the description says 'Defaults Source to Auto generated by spf13/cobra only when Source is empty and autogen text is not disabled' — this is correct, but the description also says 'Defaults Title to the uppercased command path with spaces replaced by the escaped man-page separator \\-' which matches the implementation (\\- in the description maps to \- in the actual string replacement), so no real inaccuracy here.

genMan: the description says 'While processing parents, visits all parents and propagates any DisableAutoGenTag value found on an ancestor onto the current command' — the implementation only propagates when c.DisableAutoGenTag is true (it never sets it back to false), which is a subtle but potentially misleading omission in the description.
